reflectionQuestion: When you feel really tired, what is something that helps you keep going?
title: Elijah and the Kind Woman
reflectionText:
Elijah was tired and hungry. The woman had almost nothing left. But when she shared her last bit of food, God made sure the flour and oil never ran out. Sometimes when we feel like we have nothing left to give, God provides in ways we do not expect.

When you feel really tired, what is something that helps you keep going?

scriptureKeyVerse.text: Elijah said to her, “Don’t be afraid. Go and do as you have said; but make me a little cake from it first, and bring it out to me, and afterward make some for you and for your son.
